Shop.title: Shop
Shop.description: Public shop profile created by a home-based woman artisan in Pakistan.

ownerId.description: Owner identifier or manage token for the creator of the shop.

shopName.description: Artisan or shop name displayed on the public shop page.

agreeToShareContact.description: Whether the user agreed to share her WhatsApp contact details publicly.

whatsappNumber.description: Optional WhatsApp phone number, stored only if agreeToShareContact is true.

isHidden.description: Whether the shop is hidden from public visitors.

isSample.description: Whether the shop is a seeded sample shop displaying a Sample data badge.

products.description: List of up to 3 suggested products with name, description, price, and compressed photos.

photos.description: Compressed data URLs of the artisan's work (1 to 4 photos).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the shop was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the shop was last updated.
